svg.title: Code map views
svg.desc: Four screenshots of the Compound code map on the Hono repository. Trace shows the import path from src/hono.ts to src/router/trie-router/node.ts. Changed shows the uncommitted edits and the files connected to them. Source shows a read-only preview of a file's code. Tablet shows the map with its inspector at 1024 by 768 pixels.
svg.text: More than a picture of your code
Four views from the map, on the open-source Hono repository (531 files)
How hono.ts reaches the trie router's node.ts, file by file
Your uncommitted edits and every file wired to them
Read a file's code without leaving the map
The same map and inspector at 1024 × 768
